spans.text: ...SOP-II finds shelter and collapses to the ground.
She looks at her tiny little companion, resting in her hand.
RO...
...SOP-II gives RO's core a shake.
There is no response.
Of course...you can't hear anything.
Isn't it nice, not having to be drenched by the rain, not having to walk, not having to think...
You've always been better at the last one, right...?
...SOP-II studies RO's core.
RO, I need you...
...SOP-II thinks.
She devotes all her processing power to looking for a way to survive.
I'll just...put you in here for now...
...SOP-II grabs RO's core and stuffs it inside her body.
(Whimpers)... RO, you're so cold...
I should have warmed you up a little with my hands before putting you in me, haha...
RO?
...There is no response.
But of course... RO won't wake up unless she has power.
Neural cloud cores can't go without power for too long...
It's been a while now, the core's internal emergency power supply must be almost used up...
But if I use my own power supply to charge her, I won't be able to fight for long in future battles.
It looks like I'll need to find an auxiliary power supply to charge RO up.
And after that... I still need to find a safe place. RO's core is too fragile, but I have to find a way to back her data up onto me.
Then...where should I go...?
...SOP-II sighs.
I've got no idea at all...
If only you could speak, RO...
A suggestion, or an order would be fine...
...SOP-II stares at RO's core and is silent for a long time. Then, she curls into a ball.
I just...don't want to be left behind...
Where...should I go...?
...After a long time, everything fades into silent emptiness.
...Until?
